title.value: A Reproducible and Realistic Evaluation of Partial Domain Adaptation Methods
title.justification: The title of the paper is explicitly provided in the document.
title.quote: A Reproducible and Realistic Evaluation of Partial Domain Adaptation Methods

extractions.description: The paper evaluates various Partial Domain Adaptation (PDA) methods using realistic model selection strategies without relying on target labels, which is often assumed in PDA scenarios. It presents a detailed experimental setup and discusses the reproducibility and effectiveness of these methods across two datasets, OFFICE - HOME and VISDA, using multiple strategies and seed variations.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not discuss any eco-responsible applications such as climate change mitigation or adaptation, natural systems protection, or pollution. It focuses purely on the technical evaluation of domain adaptation methods in machine learning, without links to eco-responsible objectives.
primary_category.quote: As our work focus on a quantitative study of model selection methods and reproducibility of state-of-the-art partial domain adaptation methods, we do not see any potential ethical concern.
